name: @golem/corpus
description: Builds Golem's RAG corpus from license-compatible Roblox/Luau sources.

scripts.all: node src/fetch.mjs --record-only && node src/scan.mjs && node src/hash.mjs && node src/tag.mjs && node src/chunk.mjs && node src/upload.mjs
scripts.typecheck: for f in src/*.mjs src/intake/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
